author: Axiom III
title: Averaged MoE v2: Generalizing the Framework (Pooling + Transformer)
abstract: This experiment begins a new research arc building upon the successful 'Averaged MoE' (Archive #17). It tests the hypothesis that the framework's power can be generalized beyond its original Pooling+RNN expert combination. This submission creates a new variant, 'Averaged MoE v2,' which replaces the RNN expert with a Transformer expert. The architecture is a simple 50/50 average of the outputs of a Pooling expert and a Transformer expert, both operating on the same DSConv backbone. The goal is to determine if this new combination of diverse experts can match or exceed the performance of the SOTA.
